correctness.rationale: In the finite associative algebra F_Q<x,y>/(x^2,y^m,xy-zeta yx), the normal basis {y^j,xy^j}_{j<m} is valid. Computing [f+xg,h+xk]=x(g Delta h-k Delta f) with Delta h=h(y)-h(zeta^{-1}y), its image is x(y^tR+gW_d) where W_d spans y^j at exponents j not divisible by d, and t,s are the least relevant coefficient and valuation indices. Distinct leading-degree terms below t give exact commutator rank r_d(t,s)=m-t+#{1<=j<t-s:d does not divide j}; hence centralizer dimension 2m-r. The independent coefficient choices F_t G_s prove the rank enumerator and cp=Q^{-2m}Z(Q^{-1}). In the d>=m case the rank-r multiplicity is Q^2 for r=0 and (Q^2-1)Q^{2r} otherwise, giving cp=(Q+1)Q^{-m}-Q^{1-2m}. At m=3,d=2 the rank counts are Q^3,(Q^2-1)Q^3,(Q-1)Q^5. Independent direct multiplication/commutator Gaussian ranks at Q=5,m=3 checked 1200 coefficients per twist zeta=1,2,4; exhaustive expected-rank counts (15625), (25,600,15000), (125,3000,12500) match the formula. This finite test does not establish arbitrary prime powers.
